chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Were it not for women, Allah would truly be worshiped, truly.

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One truly deserving of worship
key_terms.النِّسَاءُ: women; mentioned here as a source of worldly trial and attachment
key_terms.حَقًّا: truly; with real due fulfillment and sincerity
key_terms.لَعُبِدَ: would have been worshiped; indicating the act of devotion to Allah

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the effect of worldly attachment on true worship of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a stark moral warning about how attachment can distract people from sincere worship of Allah. It highlights the spiritual trial connected to worldly relationships and the need to preserve devotion and taqwa.
